UPDATE 06 MARCH 2026

The effort is continuing to go through the government review process. We expect to release the RFP NLT 30 APRIL 2026. No Response is required until the official RFP is posted. 

UPDATE 10 December 2025

The timeline of this effort has shift following the Government shutdown. The effort is continuing to go through the DOGE reviews. We expect to release the RFP in the spring of 2026.

UPDATE 17 AUGUST 2025

The Government is continuing through the acquisition process, including reviews by DOGE, we expect to release the RFP prior to the end of calendar year 2025.

UPDATE 01 MAY 2025

Attendee List Added. 

UPDATE 03 MARCH 2025

The requirement has been assigned a Notice ID - FA239625RB003. This ID will be used for all correspondance going forward. 

The slides from the 19 February 2025 Industry Day have been uploaded.

All questions from Industry Day are being compiled and will be posted NLT 14 March 2025.

Industry Day Announcement: 711th Human Performance Wing Mission Support Services Follow-on Contract

When: 19 February 2025, 0930-1100 EST
Where: Room E213, Building 840, Area B, Wright-Patterson AFB, OH
RSVP by: 07 February 2025 to Ruth.Rutledge.2@us.af.mil - Please state if you need to attend virtually, a Teams meeting will be available. 

Additional Info:

  • This effort will be set aside for 8(a) small businesses
  • The Program Manager and Contracting Officer will hold 10-minute meetings with individual companies or teams starting at 1200 EST.
  • Schedule individual meetings and request base passes, if needed, by 07 February 2025 by contacting Ruth Rutledge at Ruth.Rutledge.2@us.af.mil.
